## Donate

**Your financial contribution is what makes this possible.**

To date, we are 100% crowdfunded, and we rely on YOU and generous people like you to
make this project work. We very much appreciate the help because we are a small (and
dedicated) of-the-community-for-the-community collaboration, and we depend on community
support to achieve our mission.

To donate to Copyleft Cultivars, click the button below.

[Donate Now](https://www.patreon.com/CopyleftCultivarsNonprofit){.btn .btn-primary role="button"}
